headline: Target (TGT) Faces Formula Lawsuit As Fair Value Stays Just Out Of Reach
summary: Target (TGT) is under fresh scrutiny after being named in a lawsuit tied to Nara Organics infant formula that allegedly caused a confirmed case of infant botulism in Washington, which is part of a broader FDA and CDC outbreak investigation. See our latest analysis for Target. The Nara Organics lawsuit lands at a time when Target's share price has a year to date return of 39.63% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 37.63%, while its 5 year total shareholder return is down 36.52%.
